zinc_binding.note: Catalytic motif; second pattern overlaps first. Not SVMP-specific; inactive variants may lack it.

disintegrin_binding.note: Integrin-recognition motifs also occur in processed disintegrins and unrelated proteins; not proof of a P-II domain.

disintegrin_like.note: Reported ECD-associated and DDCD variants. Short patterns are supporting evidence only; some patterns overlap.
